name: Autodesk Flow Studio
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Create images and 3D models from a prompt or a photo with Autodesk® Flow Studio in ChatGPT, and keep refining them in the chat.

What you can do:
- Create an image from a text prompt, then edit it by describing the change or generate a new variation.
- Turn a prompt or an image into a draft 3D model and view it in an interactive viewer.
- Refine a model by rebuilding its mesh at the level of detail you need, and retexture it from a prompt or a reference image.
- Download models as GLB, OBJ, STL or 3MF for 3D printing, games, film and design work.
- Browse your Flow Studio library to pick up where you left off on past projects and generations.
- Pick the AI model for each step and save the ones you use most as defaults.

What you need:
- An Autodesk account with a Flow Studio Lite plan or higher.

About Autodesk

From the buildings we live and work in, to the cars we drive and the bridges we drive over. From the products we use and rely on, to the movies and games that inspire us. For more information, visit autodesk.com.
